profile_text.body:
Palantir is a public company, founded in 2003 and headquartered in Palo Alto, that trades under the ticker PLTR. Its website says it builds software that empowers organizations to effectively integrate their data, decisions, and operations, and describes itself with the tagline "Foundational Software of Tomorrow. Delivered Today."

The company's tracked AI product is Palantir AIP, listed under Data & Analytics AI. It is described as an enterprise AI platform with Ontology-based governance, a defense and intelligence focus, and use in high-stakes decision influence.

Among the legal matters on record is a case in the District Court, D. Delaware, Haugland v. Anthropic PBC. Palantir holds CIK 0001321655.
